title: Forgotten Books Journal Cards Kit
author: Unnique Design
description:
Step inside **The Society of Forgotten Books** — a vintage-inspired collection of rare books, secret correspondence, library records and literary keepsakes.
**What’s included**
• 60 journal cards in total: 30 with text and 30 matching blank cards
• 10 journal card sheets, with 6 cards per sheet
• 20 coordinating elements on 1 PNG sheet with a transparent background
• 6 backing papers arranged across 3 sheets
• 1 complete, 14-page print-ready PDF
• Separate PDFs for the journal card and backing-paper sheets
**Format**
• US Letter landscape — 11 × 8.5 inches
• Cards are arranged on sheets for printing and cutting
• The elements PNG has a transparent background for print and digital projects
**Ideal for**
Junk journals, scrapbooks, reading journals, book clubs, invitations, collages, stationery and literary-themed gifts. Use the cards with text as finished pieces, or add your own words to the matching blank versions.
**Beautiful printables for inspired days.**
Unnique Design
